purpose: Matched 2025 source-defined diagnostic counterfactuals for Niagara generation, within-zone load allocation and interface operators.
topology: dated commissioning states; exactly the baseline 148-bus model
fixed_boundaries: All28 external generator equivalents, original4DC schedules and2 observed P34 transfers stay exactly fixed.
primary_scoring: All primary scenarios use the exact8651mask; no observation-based exclusion. Infeasible literal hypotheses cannot be called full-cohort results.

Niagara.primary_compensation: Other conventionalHY outside zonesA/B excludingStLawrence; preserve hourly statewideHY total and original unit bounds.
Niagara.compensation_sensitivity: All other conventionalHY excludingStLawrence; distinguish this from the outsideA/B pool.
Niagara.bounded_legacy: Explicit nearest-feasible projection of the requested hypothesis target; report all changes without modifying source data.
Niagara.monthly_scope: Source EIA monthly energy divided by actual local-calendar physical hours defines a mean. Matching that mean on the fixed qualified cohort is conditional and does not claim full-month energy reconciliation.
Niagara.feasibility: Report raw requested-target infeasibility, and month-level feasibility before scoring; no capacity relaxation.

load.scope: Original npcc.csv versus released npcc_new.csv nonnegative bus load shares; preserve every zonalPD/QDtotal and all generation.
load.negative_and_null_controls: A shares are identical; A-only should be a no-op and AB should equal B-only.
load.extremal_test: A priori simplex bounds across retainedA/Bbuses demonstrate maximum operator response without fitting demand to observations.

mapping.physical_alternative: Only evaluate an as-built physical gate if every member/sign/terminal maps independently. Incomplete coverage is a documented identifiability gap, never a zero-filled operator.
mapping.fixed: Identical flows/angles/injections for operator-only comparisons; no network parameter changes.

analysis.families: One factor at a time; fully crossed Niagara plus load cases only as algebraic interaction checks when load-cut invariance holds.
analysis.internal_observations: Read only in separate posthoc score command after all candidate definitions and input hashes are sealed.
analysis.outputs: All7interfaces, annual/monthly MW metrics/WAPE, matchedbaseline metrics per diagnostic mask, component deltas, feasibility and independent validation.
analysis.attribution: Changes measure sensitivity to declared hypotheses, not shares of true error. Residual after tests is not automatically assigned to interface mapping.
